```python
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    result = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]

            is_sep_row = all(grid[r][k] == 4 for k in range(cols))
            is_sep_col = all(grid[k][c] == 4 for k in range(rows))
            
            if is_sep_row and is_sep_col:

    return result
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    
    # Find horizontal separator rows (all same value)
    sep_value = grid[0][0] if rows > 0 and cols > 0 else 4
    sep_rows = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        if all(grid[r][c] == sep_value for c in range(cols)):
            sep_rows.add(r)
    
    # Find vertical separator columns
    sep_cols = set()
    for c in range(cols):
        if all(grid[r][c] == sep_value for r in range(rows)):
            sep_cols.add(c)
    
    result = [[0 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if r in sep_rows or c in sep_cols:
                result[r][c] = sep_value
            else:
                # Content cell - check original grid
                val = grid[r][c]
                # Background is 5 in test, treat as background if it matches most common non-scalar
                if val == 5:  # background
                    result[r][c] = 5
                else:
                    result[r][c] = val
    
    return result
```
